idea.title: Piscinao barbatana
idea.text: Piscinão de Ramos: ele afunda até o bigode e só o topete fica fora d'água, como barbatana de tubarão

script.title: Piscinao barbatana
script.premise: No Piscinão de Ramos, Gersinho, de camisa e calça boca de sino, com água pela cintura, faz o passo brega; depois dobra os joelhos e afunda até a água bater no bigode, e só o topete enorme e seco fica de pé fora d'água, como barbatana, com os olhos dele encarando a lente.
script.gag_without_sound: ele afunda e sobra só o topete gigante e seco fora d'água, feito barbatana de tubarão, com os olhos sérios na linha d'água

location.place: Piscinão de Ramos, água rasa perto da areia
location.time_of_day: domingo de sol forte, meio da manhã

camera.height: altura do peito de quem está na beira d'água, a 3 m

beats.action: com água pela cintura, faz o passo brega: ombros pendulares e indicador subindo e descendo no tempo
beats.extras: banhistas adultos boiando e conversando, um vendedor de mate passa na areia ao fundo

beats.action: dobra os joelhos e afunda até a água bater no bigode; só o topete seco e os olhos ficam fora d'água, encarando a lente

script.end_state: água na altura do bigode, olhos sérios na linha d'água encarando a lente, o topete enorme, seco e brilhante de pé fora d'água como barbatana

storyboard_panels.description: água pela cintura, pose de assinatura, topete inteiro, piscinão e banhistas ao fundo
pico do passo, ombro esquerdo baixo, dedo pra cima
joelhos dobrando, linha d'água subindo pelo peito até o queixo
água no bigode, olhos na linha d'água, topete seco de pé fora d'água

script.start_frame: Gersinho de frente para a câmera dentro do Piscinão de Ramos, água pela cintura, camisa estampada e calça branca molhadas, dedo pra cima, mão na barriga, topete inteiro visível, banhistas e areia ao fundo
script.end_frame: água na altura do bigode, só os olhos sérios e o topete seco fora d'água, como barbatana

music.trend_sound_hint: brega romântico em alta; opcional: as duas notas do tema de tubarão na entrada do afundamento (pós, royalty-free)

script.caption: Domingo no Piscinão. O Gerson foi discreto.
script.originality_note: primeiro gag de escala por subtração (o corpo some e o topete fica); primeiro gag na água; sem contraparte nenhuma (formato Jean Phil).
brand_safety: só adultos em segundo plano, nenhuma criança em destaque
roupas de banho comuns, nada sensual
script.risks: o modelo afundar também o topete ou deixá-lo molhado e mole; olhos sumirem embaixo d'água; ondas grandes demais. Conferir no end frame os olhos acima da linha d'água e o topete inteiro e seco.

en.gag_sentence: In the shallow water of the Piscinão de Ramos he does his signature brega move waist-deep, then bends his knees and sinks until the water reaches his mustache, leaving only his deadpan eyes and his huge, dry, rigid pompadour standing above the water like a shark fin.
en.location: the Piscinão de Ramos, a large public saltwater lagoon-pool in Rio de Janeiro's north zone: calm greenish water, a strip of light sand with beach umbrellas behind, apartment blocks on the horizon, strong Sunday morning sun
en.location_map: Frame-left: two adult bathers standing chest-deep 6 m away. Center: him standing waist-deep in calm water. Frame-right: one adult bather floating on her back 7 m away. Background: the sand strip with colorful beach umbrellas and one mate vendor walking along the sand, apartment blocks on the horizon.
en.position: standing waist-deep in calm water, centered, chest square to the lens, the waterline at his belt, the camera at water-edge chest height so the pompadour fills the upper third of the frame
en.signature_pose: left hand flat on his belly just above the waterline, right index finger raised beside his head
en.extras_tasks: two adult bathers stand chest-deep at frame-left talking to each other, one adult bather floats on her back at frame-right looking at the sky, one mate vendor walks along the sand in the background carrying two metal drums on a shoulder pole
en.props: no handheld props; the water surface is calm with small ripples
en.hands: He has exactly two hands: left hand flat on his belly just above the waterline, right hand with the index finger raised.

stages.text: He holds the signature pose from the start frame, waist-deep in the calm water; breathing lifts the chest, one slow blink.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens
stages.end_state: same pose, waterline at his belt.

stages.text: Real-time, at 95 BPM: his shoulders sway once to frame-left and once to frame-right on the beat, the water rippling around his waist; his raised right index finger moves up and down twice on the beat; his left hand stays flat on his belly.
stages.facing: chest within 30° of the lens while the shoulders sway, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens
stages.end_state: shoulders level, finger raised, waterline at his belt.

stages.text: He bends his knees and sinks straight down in one steady move; the waterline climbs his chest, his shoulders and his chin and stops at his mustache; his eyes stay just above the water, fixed on the lens; his hands go under the water; the pompadour stays dry and rigid above the water, standing up like a shark fin, its outline unchanged; small ripples spread out from him.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens under the water, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens
stages.end_state: waterline at the mustache, eyes above the water, the dry pompadour standing above the water.

stages.text: Everything holds: the waterline stays at his mustache, the ripples settle, and the dry pompadour stands above the water like a shark fin; his eyes stare into the lens with one slow blink. The final frame matches the end frame.
stages.facing: face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens at the waterline
stages.end_state: only the eyes, the top of the head and the dry pompadour above the calm water, deadpan.

en.end_change: the waterline is at his mustache: only his deadpan eyes, forehead and the huge rigid black pompadour are above the water; the pompadour is dry and glossy, standing up like a shark fin, outline unchanged; his hands and body are under the water
en.lighting: Strong late-morning sun from upper frame-left, bright specular glints on the water, hard shadows under the beach umbrellas, 5600K.
